concepts.proposed_markdown: - [[source-adyen-docs-marketplaces-view-transfers-details]] — 2019-modified, 2026-09-15-captured Marketplace Customer Area/Transfers API guide for list/detail transfer reads, status/event inspection and webhook tracking; list-query examples conflict with stated filters and booked bank example does not prove receipt.
warnings: GET /transfers prose limits date range to under six months and requires an identifier, but examples span a year in prose or omit the identifier in curl (raw lines 77–100).
Illustrative bank transfer is booked with counterpartyAccountNotFound reason and estimated arrival; do not infer beneficiary-bank receipt (raw lines 273–390).
